column3: Content Security Policy (CSP) not enforced — CSP is set via reverse proxy/nginx, not application layer
Redis/Postgres health endpoints are internal and expose no sensitive data
Timestamp disclosure is intentional for debugging — no sensitive data leaked
Webhook endpoint uses raw-body parser; Stripe signature verification is in application code, not at parser level
Current page is the root page — expected
Browser info disclosure not relevant for API
Non-authoritative cookie is expected for session tracking
Application error page is controlled; stack traces are disabled in production
Loosely scoped cookie is set by the framework; session is additionally validated server-side
X-Content-Type-Options already set by NestJS Helmet middleware
Web Browser XSS Protection is deprecated; CSP handles this
